Rumors suggest Apple will use "iPhone Ultra" as the brand name for its upcoming foldable model, and Mark Gurman says this is indeed a name widely used within the company.

It is reported that the "iPhone Ultra" foldable phone name is used internally at Apple

Apple will unveil the highly anticipated foldable iPhone at its September event next month.

Since rumors about the first foldable iPhone began circulating, the device has generally been referred to as the "iPhone Fold".

However, earlier this year, leakers began claiming that "iPhone Ultra" would be the name of this product.

Although this cannot be said to be a confirmation of Apple's plans, well-informed leaker Mark Gurman posted on X today: "Everyone internally is calling it Ultra".

"Ultra" is a name commonly used by many Apple employees, but it does not mean it is the final brand name.

Apple has always been secretive, so many employees often don't know about unannounced products unless they are directly involved in the related work.

The reason why "iPhone Ultra" is used internally may simply be because outside sources have been calling this foldable phone that. But in reality, only core members of Apple's marketing department and other informed employees may know the true naming plans for the product.

Do you think iPhone Ultra will be the name of the foldable phone? What other name might have a better chance? Feel free to tell us your thoughts in the comments section.
